ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

21. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Home ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
